name: Dasoku
source:
A popular utaite who is known for his deep and lazy-sounding yet smooth voice, which has a slight lisp.

He is responsible for the visual novel's opening and ending themes.

[From [url=http://utaite.wikia.com/wiki/Dasoku]Utaite Wiki[/url]]
